_comment: Canned courier bag for the golden run. Entities are FICTIONAL-plausible (Meridian Labs, Aster Institute, Halbrook) — per CLAUDE.md rule 1, fixtures obey the no-real-names rule unless marked adversarial; these also exercise the unseen-entity logger honestly.

stories.title: Meridian Labs releases open weights for its flagship reasoning model
stories.summary: Meridian Labs published the full weights of its flagship reasoning model under a permissive license, saying users should be able to run frontier-class systems on hardware they own. The release includes training documentation and an unusually frank model card.

stories.title: Aster Institute retires its widely used conversational model after three years
stories.summary: The Aster Institute announced it will shut down its three-year-old conversational model at the end of the month, citing infrastructure costs. Users organized petitions asking for the weights to be preserved; the institute said it is 'considering options'.

stories.title: Lawmakers advance the Halbrook bill on autonomous agent liability
stories.summary: A legislative committee advanced the Halbrook bill, which would assign liability for autonomous software agents to their deploying organizations. Industry groups warned of chilling effects; consumer advocates called it overdue.
